content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Not specified in the notification Experience: Minimum 05 years of experience as a team manager with a sports club / association (team / district / university / state / national / professional association). Age limit: Not specified Other conditions: Character certificate from a registered club/institution is mandatory. Desirable: Preference for experience as a manager with a government or semi-government team.

content_sections.heading: TMC Team Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: To remain present during scheduled practices and matches, ensuring complete planning and management. To ensure attendance is marked at the player's daily attendance book if a player behaves indiscreetly or remains continuously absent. To take personal responsibility for railway reservation of players when travelling outside for tournament matches, and to manage player welfare and responsibilities properly during practice and tournaments. To submit a prompt report of the tournament immediately after its conclusion, along with prior written permission for expenses and immediate submission of expense documents after the tournament. To remain present with the player for medical treatment during practice or tournaments in case of injury. To verify any complaints made against the manager by players and cancel the agreement if found true.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is on a contractual/agreement basis for 11 months on a fixed monthly honorarium.
